from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCategory(BaseModel):
    """The specific legal cause-of-action category for a single document."""
    category: str | None = Field(description="The case category extracted from the document")

class Document(BaseModel):
    """One judicial document with its title and assigned cause-of-action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judicial document, e.g. '《判决文书 a》'")
    case_category: str = Field(description="The specific case category from the task list: '合同，无因管理，不当得利纠纷', '非刑事赔偿-错误执行赔偿', '刑事赔偿', '行政行为 - 其他行政行为', '劳动争议，人事争议', '行政行为 - 行政处罚'")
    key_facts: str | None = Field(description="Short evidence from the text supporting the category (e.g., 'Labor dispute', 'Administrative penalty')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
